title_en: Dinner for $4 — Inside a Convenience Store 🍙 #shorts
description_en: In Korea, dinner sometimes comes from a 편의점 (pyeonuijeom) — a convenience store. Triangle kimbap, cup ramyeon, free hot water, a microwave, and a counter by the window. Stock footage: Pexels (free license)
hook_en: Dinner for $4 — inside a convenience store.
hook_vi: Bữa tối 4 đô — ngay trong cửa hàng tiện lợi.
hook_id: Makan malam 4 dolar — di dalam minimarket.
hook_es: Cena por 4 dólares — dentro de una tienda de conveniencia.
hook_pt: Jantar por 4 dólares — dentro de uma loja de conveniência.
hook_ar: عشاء بأربعة دولارات — داخل بقالة صغيرة.
hook_fil: Hapunan sa 4 na dolyar — sa loob ng convenience store.
hook_hi: चार डॉलर का डिनर — सुविधा स्टोर के अंदर।
